augmentation_trends.matched_population_note: Every level is restricted to the tasks carrying an augmented (L>=1) record and collapsed to one cell per (task, level) by any-sample success, so L0 and L1-L4 span the identical task set (gate7 finding 1). The prior unmatched comparison folded the full multi-sample L0 corpus against the single-sample augmented records.

pass_at_3.derivation: probability at least 1 of 3 passes (Chen et al. 2021: 1-C(n-c,3)/C(n,3))
